title: The SH02 lands again at every story start: 5.3 s of landing, then a close-up on Isao for his three lines while the rocket is swapped for its salvage behind the camera; 8.5 s, any key or tap skips it
context: Owner, 2026-09-25, playtesting the live build: "bring back the landing, short and sweet but showing the landing. Isao comes out, close up on his face; he's the narrator. 'Rough landing!' 'So Much to Build', 'I'll get started on recycling the rocket'. The state change from rocket intact to dismantled should happen off camera to hide the fact we do not have an animation for it." He chose about 8 s, at every story start (a bare page; not the SKIP TUTORIAL run, not explicit stage=N/story=N jump links), any key or click skips it. Before: the landing had never been in the game, only in the story lab (src/labs/story-tab.js, 30.3 s). A bare story page opened on the chase view with the SH02 already standing, Isao hovering 18 m over it; the beats said 'rough_landing' and 'so_much_to_build' at 0.6 and 2.0 s (once per browser, so later visits said nothing) and at 2.5 s deployed the AFR-01, swapping the intact rocket for the salvage in plain view of that camera; the 'foundry_deploy' line queued behind the faces and was usually dropped. Two latent bugs sat under it: paintBrief's `isao.faceLock = ...` was inside a // comment, so the drone never wore a line's face, and nothing ran Isao's face, clips or rotors while a shot froze the world, so the study close-up showed a stopped drone; and a landmark hidden or shown before its model loaded stayed as it loaded.
outcome: src/fx/arrival.js (new) plays two shots over the base's own landmarks, no second rocket. 'arrival' (5.3 s): the SH02 comes down 150 m along its own up in 2.6 s on the lab's timeline cut short (STORY_ARRIVAL in src/content/story-defaults.js; the clock is src/domain/arrival-shot.js over src/domain/landing-sequence.js, which gains optional shockClip/doorClip so the door can open while the authored shock plays on), legs out before touchdown, the shock and door clips scrubbed (base-layout now also holds Landing_Shock on the SH02, at its end, the rest pose), the lab's six plumes under the skirt, scorch and dust; Isao climbs out of the well at 0.4 of his game size (the six metre drone would not fit it), angry, and flies 35 m toward the pole to his own hover height while the lens closes to 30 degrees and the rocket leaves the frame. 'arrivalTalk' (3.2 s): a cut to his face (src/domain/story-shots.js isaoFace) through a 20 degree lens, the camera between him and the rocket and looking away from it; in that same tick the beats deploy the AFR-01 (story-beats `arrival` option and deploy(api)), so the rocket becomes its salvage and the foundry where no camera looks. His lines are one beat, arrival_talk in src/isaobriefs.js (not once per browser, faces angry, glee, determined, `dwell` 1.2 s and 1.4 s read by a new lineDwell), and the close-up holds the first two and 0.6 s of the third, which he finishes over the chase view of the salvage and the foundry. Then the lens is restored, the chase view snapped, Isao handed back at his hover radius drifting to the foundry. A key or tap at any point ends on the same end state (before the cut the swap happens with the cut to the chase view). The HUD is hidden while it plays (styles.css body.arrival-on) except Isao's panel and the SKIP TUTORIAL offer. Until the shot the rocket is hidden the frame it loads and Isao is hidden, and it starts only once the rocket, its salvage, the foundry and Isao are all loaded; after 30 s or a load error the beats are released without a shot and a landmark that loads later is put in the end state once. src/platform/story-world.js turns it on for a growing base at stage 1 with no phase: the bare page, the burger's Story (story=1&grow=1), ?grow=1; SKIP TUTORIAL, static stage=N/story=N links and phase jumps do not play it. The beats' timed deploy now says 'foundry_deploy' itself (it was the controller's foundry hook), so the arrival's deploy says nothing. Isao's face: the faceLock assignment is code again and the face, rotor and work-light block moved from updateIsao to src/fx/isao-look.js, which the frozen frame runs as well (the study close-up now wears neutral, skeptical, determined). The SH02's bell, well floor and rim are content (SH02_WELL), shared with the lab. td-tab 9,454 -> 9,437 lines, 537,879 -> 536,986 bytes, 19 long lines (the host is storyApi's camera, startShot, snapCamera and drone, ticked every frame). The beats freeze under the shots as under every shot, so the opening after the landing moves later: see evidence for the timeline.
alternatives: Porting the lab's own landing (a second SH02 model, src/labs/story-landing.js): the game may not import src/labs, and a second rocket would need the base's to hide and a hand-over between two models; the base's own landmark on the lab's timeline has no hand-over at all.

The owner's three lines as the old two once-per-browser beats plus the foundry line: the brief queue holds one waiting beat and drops the rest, and once-per-browser lines are silent on every later visit; one beat of three lines said at every start cannot lose a line.

Holding the close-up for all three lines at the reading curve's floor (2.4, 2.4, 3.1 s): the whole arrival would be about 13 s against the owner's eight; the first two lines are timed to the shot and the third is finished over the base it is about.
Keeping Isao at his game size in the well: a 7 m wide drone through a 6 m hull clips through the rocket; he comes out small and is his game size from the cut, which no frame compares.

Showing the ground from the first frame of the descent: on a 753 m planet the horizon from a camera 45 m up is 19 degrees down, so a frame holding a rocket 150 m up and the ground needs a lens near 60 degrees; the shot looks up at the rocket and tilts down with it instead.
evidence: npm test (150 test programs), npm run check (architecture: td-tab 9,437 lines, 536,986 bytes, 19 long lines, budgets lowered) and npm run build green on the branch; npm run architecture and the eslint no-undef/no-unused diff of td-tab against playtest-fixes 34af28d7 show nothing new

test/arrival-shot.mjs: the shipped tune lands (falling all the way, the plume cut at touchdown), the legs are out by touchdown, the door opens inside the shock, both clips play to their authored ends, Isao waits in the hull until the door, climbs straight up past the rim and arcs out to the host point, and landing plus close-up is 8.5 s. test/arrival.mjs drives src/fx/arrival.js on a recording host with real three.js nodes (the waits, the rocket hidden the frame it loads, the cut in one tick, the camera between Isao and the rocket and looking away, both ends, three kinds of skip, the give-up and the late landmarks); ten mutants of the module all fail it. test/story-beats.mjs: with the option nothing is said or deployed in 30 s, deploy(api) deploys once from landed only; without it the old opening is unchanged and its deploy says foundry_deploy. test/isaobriefs.mjs: a real face per line, dwell only for its own lines, lineDwell falls back to the curve

Browser, each through scripts/browser-lock.sh on the committed tree (046533c8) and again --grow, --skip-tutorial and --showcase on the final tree: --grow green. Its page log: 318 frames of the landing all with the intact rocket and no salvage or foundry, 193 frames of the close-up all with the salvage and the foundry and no rocket, the frame before the first close-up frame is the landing (the swap is on the cut), nothing between the two shots, the lines Rough landing! / So much to build! over his face and the third begun on it, the lens and the HUD back after; stills artifacts/browser/grow-arrival.png (Isao out of the open hatch, angry, the nose and the ground below), grow-arrival-talk.png (the 20 degree close-up, the glee face and So much to build!), grow-landing.png (the chase view: the salvage, the foundry, Isao, the third line)

--story-world green (rotor heat peak 0.2023; the study close-up now wears the line face), --skip-tutorial green (the offer stands over the landing; the skipped run has no arrival), --showcase green (PLAY lands the SH02 and Rough landing! shows), the default suite green (48 steps), --pacing green. --story passes every landing step of the lab and stops at twelve landmarks at stage 8 (15 !== 12) exactly as on playtest-fixes 34af28d7 without this change (a baseline run): the three later expedition sites load concealed since 2026-09-14

The opening moves about 5 s later. --grow, marks from the page being ready, playtest-fixes 34af28d7 -> this branch: Rotor printed 25.1 -> 30.4, gate stands 39.6 -> 44.9, tremor 40.4 -> 45.7, first fodder 42.8 -> 48.2, Stålheart print begins 47.5 -> 52.8, override 57.0 -> 62.3, first wave cleared 72.3 -> 77.0, hull out 126.5 -> 131.5, handover 136.3 -> 145.5 (the harness clears sector 0 at its own pace), study 153.8 -> 163.0; the arrival itself 0.1-8.7 s with the cut at 5.5 s. --pacing (game seconds), baseline -> branch: AFR-01 deploys 2.0 -> 5.2 (the cut), Rotor ready 24.7 -> 30.0, gate 39.2 -> 44.7, tremor 40.0 -> 45.5, override 56.7 -> 62.7, wave cleared 70.7 -> 77.7, construction 84.7 -> 91.8, hull out 123.7 -> 129.0, handover 145.7 -> 151.2, expedition 163.4 -> 168.8, sector 1 card 277.2 -> 282.6 (first contact 21.2 -> 21.0 s), sector 2 card 412.2 -> 416.1
